title: 2.6 International Conventions and Agreements on Climate Change
description: World climate conferences, the IPCC, UNFCCC negotiations, Kyoto Protocol and Paris Agreement. Hard level.

questions.question: Why did global emissions rise over 25 percent from 1990 to 2012 despite Kyoto?
options: Major emitters stayed outside or were exempt from reduction duties
questions.correctAnswer: Major emitters stayed outside or were exempt from reduction duties

questions.question: What does carbon neutral mean?
options: Net greenhouse gas emissions offset by activities such as planting trees
questions.correctAnswer: Net greenhouse gas emissions offset by activities such as planting trees

questions.question: How many countries had joined the Convention by 2006?
What was significant about the Second World Climate Conference in 1990?
options: It included ministers as well as scientists
questions.correctAnswer: It included ministers as well as scientists

questions.question: What did the 1996 no regrets safeguards refer to?
options: Cost-effective steps consistent with sustainable development
A ban on all energy use
questions.correctAnswer: Cost-effective steps consistent with sustainable development

questions.question: How does emissions trading relate to the Kyoto framework?
options: It is a tax on rainfall
It is a market mechanism agreed in the Bonn Agreements to help meet targets
It was created by the Toronto Conference
questions.correctAnswer: It is a market mechanism agreed in the Bonn Agreements to help meet targets

questions.question: What shift in focus occurred at COP 8?
options: Negotiations on a new treaty began
Implementation of the Marrakesh Accords became central
questions.correctAnswer: Implementation of the Marrakesh Accords became central

questions.question: What explains the exemption of many developing nations from Kyoto cuts?
options: They had no industries at all
They refused to join the United Nations
They were located in the Southern Hemisphere
They had contributed only a small part of accumulated carbon dioxide
questions.correctAnswer: They had contributed only a small part of accumulated carbon dioxide

questions.question: Which benefit is listed for cutting greenhouse gas emissions?
options: Reduced acid rain, haze and photochemical smog
questions.correctAnswer: Reduced acid rain, haze and photochemical smog

questions.question: What was the role of the INC?
options: It was the negotiating body for the Framework Convention on Climate Change
It published the Fifth Assessment Report
questions.correctAnswer: It was the negotiating body for the Framework Convention on Climate Change
